question.text: An Aggressive Hybrid Fund must invest within which equity allocation range as per SEBI categorization?

answer.text: 65% to 80% in equity and equity-related instruments
40% to 60% in equity and equity-related instruments
75% to 90% in equity and equity-related instruments
50% to 70% in equity and equity-related instruments

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI's scheme categorization for hybrid funds, an Aggressive Hybrid Fund invests 65% to 80% in equity and equity-related instruments, with the remaining 20% to 35% in debt instruments. This 65-80% equity band is the source-backed allocation rule for the category. The Trap: The frequent confusion is between Aggressive Hybrid (65-80% equity) and Balanced Hybrid (40-60% equity); the 75-90% and 50-70% options are deliberately close but do not match the SEBI band. Conservative Hybrid sits much lower in equity. Note: Lock in the source-supported equity band of 65-80% for Aggressive Hybrid; treat any specific tax-rate or exemption figures as items that need their own source before being quoted.
